The '''Earthen Ring Memorial''' is a monument located at the [[Earthen Ring (Stonetalon Mountains)|Earthen Ring]] ritual grounds, in [[Stonetalon Mountains]]. 

==Contents==
{{Book||align=left|content=
By Storm, Earth, and Fire - our races have been united and returned the Horde to its shamanistic roots. This stone stands as a testament to our unity and as a memorial to those who fell protecting it.}}
